battle.name: 第一次阿散蒂戰爭
battle.brief: 一八二三年英國為費亞塞慘敗出動沃爾斯利遠征軍，沿黃金海岸北上封鎖庫馬西通道；一八二四年一月十八日夸曼索一役，英軍以輕野砲與火箭擊潰阿散蒂大軍，二月進軍庫馬西並縱火焚城。阿散蒂帝國靠海岸貿易得來的歐製銅野砲，也在費亞塞與和約歸還條款中反覆出現，這是歐洲火砲與西非王國第一次成建制對撞。

kit.name: 野砲
kit.history: 能拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲。它讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。

countries: 交戰雙方是英國王室的黃金海岸殖民地體系與阿散蒂帝國。英方由三層構成：最上層是駐節於開普海岸的總督府，總督查爾斯·麥卡錫掌管沿海的堡壘、軍械庫與商務裁決權；中間是英國陸軍與皇家海軍的分遣隊，沃爾斯利中將率來的步兵、工兵、醫療隊，以及一支出海作戰的砲兵小分隊，另有皇家非洲公司與西印度艦隊招募的黑人士兵；最下層是結盟的沿海諸邦，芬特、蓋、加、豪薩等邦派出民兵與將士，由當地酋長率領，作為英軍的耳目、嚮導與側翼。英方的依託是海岸線：開普海岸堡與艾爾米納等要塞由英軍駐守，商船隊的護航讓遠征軍的糧彈可以定期上岸，輔助人員則多來自維德角與剛果沿岸，負責築城、搬運與舟車。阿散蒂一方以庫馬西王廷為中樞，國王奧塞·圖圖一世統轄十餘支以刀、矛為主的師，另有一支近衛。阿散蒂以武力迫使沿海諸邦進貢「天租」，再以黃金、奴隸與象牙壯大王室的常備軍；火繩槍與銅砲則從海岸商人手中購得，彈藥集中由王宮武庫按季發放，沿海附庸邦另須供應糧食與役夫。
countriesEn: The two sides were the British Crown's Gold Coast colonial establishment and the Asante Empire. The British side was built in three layers. At the top sat the governorship at Cape Coast, where Governor Charles MacCarthy controlled the coastal forts, the ordnance depots and the commercial courts. In the middle stood detachments of the British army and the Royal Navy: the infantry, engineers and medical men brought by Lieutenant-General Sir Garnet Wolseley, together with a small field artillery detachment that had crossed the sea with them, plus black soldiers recruited by the Royal African Company and by the West India regiments. At the bottom lay the allied coastal states; Fante, Ga, Hausa and other polities sent militias and warriors led by their own chiefs to serve as eyes, guides and flanks for the British column. British strength rested on the coastline: the Cape Coast Castle and the fort at Elmina were held by British troops, escorted merchant shipping brought the expedition's food and ammunition ashore on a regular schedule, and the auxiliaries, drawn mostly from the Cape Verde and Congo coasts, handled fortification, porterage and boat work. The Asante side was centred on the Kumasi court, where King Osei Tutu I commanded more than ten divisions armed with knives and spears, with a separate bodyguard. Asante had forced the coastal states to pay the tribute known as the rent of heaven, and used the gold, slaves and ivory to build up the standing armies of the royal establishment; muskets and bronze cannon were bought from coastal merchants, ammunition was issued in batches from the royal arsenal at the palace, and the dependent coastal states had to supply food and porters in addition.
people: 英方最關鍵的人物是加尼特·沃爾斯利爵士。他於一八二三年二月率遠征軍抵達開普海岸後，拒絕在「天租」爭議上讓步，改用築堡封路、逐步推進的辦法逼迫對方談判。他的前任總督查爾斯·麥卡錫在費亞塞一役兵敗陣亡，此役成為遠征的直接導火線；隨軍的湯瑪斯·麥克道威爾曾在庫馬西居住多年，兼作通譯與中間人，其情報使英方得以掌握阿散蒂內部的裂痕與道路狀況。英方隊中還有工程官、軍醫與隨行的記錄軍官，他們留下的戰報與日誌是今日重建此戰的主要依據。阿散蒂方面，國王奧塞·圖圖一世在戰爭初期仍坐鎮庫馬西，於一八二三年間病逝，其後由其子繼位；王宮長老會在談判中周旋，既不願全盤接受英方條款，也不敢公然開戰。阿散蒂大軍由元帥統率，據英方戰報記為基爾基，手下是密集縱隊與大量標槍手。芬特諸邦的將領率部眾在兩翼作戰；據英方記錄，戰役進行中曾有沿海邦的戰士脫離阿散蒂行列，倒向英方。
peopleEn: The decisive figure on the British side was Lieutenant-General Sir Garnet Wolseley. After he reached the Cape Coast in February 1823 he refused to give ground on the question of the tribute, and instead chose to build forts, close the roads and advance by degrees in order to force a negotiation. His predecessor Charles MacCarthy, the governor, had been killed in the defeat at Feyiase, and that battle became the immediate spark of the expedition. Thomas McDowall, who had lived for years at Kumasi and served as interpreter and go-between, travelled with the column; the intelligence he supplied let the British read the divisions inside the Asante state and the condition of the roads. The British column also carried engineers, medical officers and recording officers, whose reports and journals are the main basis for reconstructing the war today. On the Asante side, King Osei Tutu I still sat at Kumasi at the opening of the war and died in the course of 1823, after which his son succeeded him; the council of elders at the palace manoeuvred in the negotiations, unwilling to accept the British terms in full and unwilling to fight openly either. The Asante host was led by a general, recorded in the British dispatches as Kyirky, with dense columns and a great number of javelin men. The commanders of the Fante states led their men on both flanks, and the British record notes that warriors from the coastal states did desert the Asante ranks during the fighting and go over to the British.
kits: 本卡的野砲是十六世紀西班牙系的輕型野砲，整門可拆成數件，由馬匹或人夫牽引行進，砲身短、射界平直，專為戰場上快速部署而造。到一八二三年，這類砲在歐洲已由六磅與九磅野砲接替，但它留下的血統仍貫通英軍的砲兵隊：遠征軍帶來數門輕野砲，由剛果與維德角出生的黑人士兵操作，砲手在潮濕林區裡靠手推與槓桿把砲送進陣位，彈藥則是有限的火藥包與球形實心彈。阿散蒂一方同樣用野砲：帝國從海岸貿易商與葡萄牙、西班牙、荷蘭商館手中購得或繳獲的銅製野砲，其中最著名的一件至今仍存於庫馬西，是一門十五、十六世紀的歐洲銅砲。據當時記載，阿散蒂在費亞塞一役曾把繳獲的野砲架在土壘後向英方射擊；一八二四年和約中，把包括野砲在內的繳獲英方失物歸還英國，是明文條款之一。除野砲之外，雙方還有火繩槍、燧發滑鎗與刺刀、長矛與皮盾、康格里夫火箭，以及由象、轎、擔夫組成的運輸隊和以玉米、薯類為主的口糧。英軍工兵另攜斧鋤，在林間砍出可供砲車通過的窄路；這種道路工程往往比戰鬥更決定遠征的速度。
kitsEn: The field gun on this card is a light gun of the sixteenth-century Spanish line, broken into several pieces and dragged by horses or by men, short in the barrel and flat in its trajectory, built for rapid deployment on the battlefield. By 1823 the type had been succeeded in Europe by six- and nine-pounder field guns, but its lineage still ran straight through the British artillery: the expedition brought a number of light field guns, worked by black soldiers born in the Congo and the Cape Verde Islands, who in the wet forest country pushed and levered the pieces into position by hand, and who had only a limited supply of powder charges and round shot to work with. The Asante used field guns as well. The empire bought or captured bronze field guns from coastal traders and from the Portuguese, Spanish and Dutch trading factories, and the most famous of them is still kept at Kumasi: a European bronze cannon of the fifteenth or sixteenth century. The records of the time state that at Feyiase the Asante set a captured gun behind an earthwork and fired it at the British; in the peace of 1824 the return to Britain of captured British property, field guns among it, was an explicit clause of the treaty. Alongside the guns, both sides had matchlock and flint muskets with bayonets, spears and leather shields, Congreve rockets, and transport drawn up from elephants, litters and porters, together with a ration of maize and tubers. The British engineers carried axes and picks as well and cut narrow tracks through the forest for the gun carriages to pass; such road work often decided the speed of the expedition more than any battle did.
tactics: 英方的戰術是典型的十九世紀殖民地遠征：先以縱隊行軍保持速度，再用設防據點切斷對方退路。沃爾斯利在通往庫馬西的路上築起夸曼索的堡壘，用一座可封鎖道路的木柵寨當作前進基地，逼迫阿散蒂必須在同一條路上與自己決戰；雨季一到，英方主力退回海岸，只留少量守軍與盟軍駐守，待一八二四年開季再集結主力推進。夸曼索交戰時，英方以堡壘式正面進攻牽制阿散蒂密集的縱隊，同時以火箭連在側翼齊射，芬特盟軍與阿兵武裝的側翼隊伍在樹林與高草間切斷退路，把整個大軍擠壓在一小塊開闊地上；英軍不待其重整即連續追擊，砲隊隨步兵前進，向退卻中的縱隊一路射擊，直取庫馬西。城內的木柵、屋頂與倉廩被砲火與火箭點燃，城市大片焚毀，而王廷成員早已避走。阿散蒂的戰術則是守土、據林、以人海正面硬撞英軍方陣，靠人多勢眾與近身纏鬥取勝。
tacticsEn: British tactics were those of a typical nineteenth-century colonial expedition: march in column to keep up speed, then use fortified posts to cut the enemy's line of retreat. Wolseley raised a fort at Kwamanso on the road to Kumasi, a wooden stockade capable of closing the road, and used it as a forward base that forced the Asante to meet him on the same road. When the rains came the main body fell back to the coast, leaving only a small garrison and allied troops to hold the post, and in the opening of the 1824 season the main force was assembled once more and pushed forward. At Kwamanso the British attacked frontally from the stockade to pin the dense Asante columns, fired a rocket troop in salvo on the flank, and sent the Fante allies and the African armed levies of the flank companies into the trees and high grass to cut the retreat, squeezing the whole army onto a small stretch of open ground. The British allowed no time for the Asante to reform: the guns advanced with the infantry and fired on the retreating columns all the way to Kumasi, where the stockades, roofs and stores of the town were set alight by gunfire and rockets and great parts of the city burned, the members of the court having long since gone. The Asante answer was to hold earthworks, to take cover in the forest and to smash head-on into the British squares with massed numbers, seeking victory through numbers and close fighting.
data: 兵力數字在雙方記載中相差頗大。費亞塞一役，一八二二年一月二十一日的英方聯軍不足千人，其中正規英軍與海軍陸戰隊不過百餘人，其餘為芬特民兵；阿散蒂方面投入數千兵力，結果英方指揮官陣亡、聯軍潰散。遠征軍在一八二三年抵達黃金海岸時約三千六百人，其中英國與西印度部隊不足一千人，其餘是芬特等沿海邦的兵力；待增援抵達，英方在夸曼索一役可投入的兵力約四千人。阿散蒂大軍的數目各書記載不一，多稱一萬至一萬五千人，其槍械比例低於英軍，火繩槍多集中於主力幾個師，其餘師別仍以刀矛作戰。夸曼索交戰英方傷亡不重，記為陣亡十餘人、受傷逾百；阿散蒂方面的損失以潰散與被追殺為主，數千人在撤退中被殲。行軍距離方面，開普海岸至庫馬西約一百六十公里，英方推進用了數週，必須趕在雨季前後作戰。戰後賠償據英方文獻記載約十二萬鎊，另有物資與權利上的讓步。
dataEn: The strength figures differ widely between the accounts of the two sides. At Feyiase, on 21 January 1822, the British-allied force numbered under a thousand, of whom barely a hundred were British regulars and Royal Marines and the rest Fante militia; the Asante committed several thousand, and the British commander was killed and the allied force scattered. The expedition that reached the Gold Coast in 1823 numbered about thirty-six hundred, of whom fewer than a thousand were British and West Indian troops and the remainder came from the coastal states such as Fante; once reinforcements had arrived, roughly four thousand men were available to the British at the battle of Kwamanso. The size of the Asante host is given differently in different books, most often as between ten and fifteen thousand; their proportion of firearms was lower than the British, the matchlocks being concentrated in a few of the main divisions while the rest fought with knives and spears. British casualties at Kwamanso were light, recorded as a dozen or so killed and more than a hundred wounded; the Asante losses took the form of a rout and of men hunted down during the pursuit, several thousand dying in the retreat. As for distance, the road from Cape Coast to Kumasi runs to about one hundred and sixty kilometres, and the British advance took several weeks, which meant the campaign had to be fought either just before or just after the rains. The indemnity after the war is recorded in British papers at about one hundred and twenty thousand pounds, together with further concessions in stores and in rights.
cause: 直接起因是阿散蒂帝國向沿海諸邦強徵的「天租」。阿散蒂在奧塞·圖圖一世治下於十八世紀末完成對黃金海岸內陸的征服，把芬特、蓋、加等邦置於王廷的宗主權之下，要求各地按年進貢黃金、象牙、奴隸與商品，並派兵常駐收租；沿海諸邦若要與英國直接交易，還須先得到王廷的允許。英屬黃金海岸總督麥卡錫起初以外交手段周旋，試圖以承認進貢換取貿易權，甚至一度提議由英方代收部分貢賦，卻未能壓住阿散蒂在費亞塞一役的攻擊；英軍指揮官陣亡後，沿海各邦要求武裝報復，本土政府於是決定出兵，派遣沃爾斯利率領遠征軍，目標是迫使阿散蒂放棄對沿海諸邦的宗主權、賠償英方損失並歸還繳獲的野砲。阿散蒂拒絕接受英方條件，談判在一八二三年中破裂，次年春天戰事全面展開。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the tribute known as the rent of heaven that the Asante Empire forced from the coastal states. Under Osei Tutu I the Asante completed their conquest of the interior of the Gold Coast towards the end of the eighteenth century, placing Fante, Ga and the other states under the suzerainty of the Kumasi court, demanding an annual tribute of gold, ivory, slaves and goods, and keeping troops in the country to collect it; a coastal state that wished to trade with Britain directly had first to obtain the court's permission. Charles MacCarthy, governor of the British Gold Coast, first tried to manage the quarrel by diplomacy, hoping to exchange recognition of the tribute for trading rights and even proposing at one point that Britain should collect part of the tribute on their behalf, but he could not check the Asante attack at Feyiase. After the British commander was killed, the coastal states demanded armed reprisal, and the home government decided to send troops: Wolseley was to lead an expedition whose aims were to force the Asante to renounce their suzerainty over the coastal states, to make good the losses of the British and to give back the captured field guns. The Asante refused the British terms, the negotiations broke down in the course of 1823, and in the spring of the following year the fighting opened in earnest.
impact: 這場戰爭把黃金海岸從一連串領地爭端變成英國的殖民地事業，也把阿散蒂帝國推入與歐洲國家反覆開戰的長週期。英方在沿海增建金塔、克里斯琴堡等據點，一八二七年英國正式在黃金海岸設立總督與行政機構，把沿海諸邦置於殖民政權之下。阿散蒂表面上接受條約、繳付賠償、遣回繳獲的野砲，實際上王廷勢力退往內陸，首都庫馬西在半個世紀後再次被英軍攻破並焚毀；阿散蒂社會的結構、語言與信仰在往後的殖民政權下逐漸被貶抑，王權與傳統兵役制度被英國法律否定，一九〇〇年「金凳戰爭」爆發，金凳被劫、阿散蒂王權流亡海外，成為一九五七年加納獨立的歷史前奏。歐洲火砲與非洲王國在黃金海岸的這次交鋒，也讓英國確認遠征阿散蒂在技術上可行，砲兵、火箭與縱隊遠征的戰術在往後的戰役中被反覆使用與改良，本地王國則在每次敗仗之後重新檢討自己的火器與軍隊組織。
impactEn: This war turned the Gold Coast from a run of territorial disputes into a British colonial undertaking, and it pushed the Asante Empire into a long cycle of wars with European powers. The British built up further posts on the coast, among them Elmina and Christiansborg, and in 1827 the Crown formally established a governor and an administration for the Gold Coast, placing the coastal states under colonial rule. Asante accepted the treaty on paper, paid the indemnity and sent back the captured field guns, but the real power of the court withdrew into the interior, and the capital Kumasi was again stormed and burned by British troops half a century later. The structure, language and belief of Asante society were gradually denigrated under the colonial regime, the royal institution and the traditional system of military service were denied by British law, and in 1900 the War of the Golden Stool broke out, the stool was carried off and the Asante monarchy was exiled overseas, a prelude to Ghanaian independence in 1957. The collision of European artillery with an African kingdom on the Gold Coast also convinced the British that an expedition into Asante country was technically feasible, and artillery, rockets and the marching column were used and refined again in later campaigns, while the local kingdoms, after every defeat, went back to reviewing their own firearms and the organisation of their armies.
result: 一八二四年一月十八日夸曼索之戰，阿散蒂大軍在正面與兩翼同時受挫，隊伍被切斷，士氣崩潰，隨即在英軍追擊下被驅散；英軍順利進軍庫馬西，城內大片屋舍與木柵被焚，國王與王廷成員早已避走，帝國的權威從此退回內陸深處。戰爭以一八二四年的和約收場：阿散蒂放棄對沿海諸邦的宗主權、確認芬特等邦的獨立，歸還包括一門繳獲的歐製野砲在內的英方失物，繳付巨額賠償（英方文獻記為約十二萬鎊），並接受英國在庫馬西設置駐節官以監督條款。麥卡錫陣亡的舊怨至此才算了結，但代價是阿散蒂在英國眼中成了必須反覆打壓的對象。表面上阿散蒂帝國得以保存、王位延續，實則此役之後黃金海岸的權力均衡已被打破，英國與阿散蒂之間維持了約半世紀的緊張，直到第三次戰爭中英國封鎖海岸、第四次戰爭攻入庫馬西才徹底打破平衡。
resultEn: At the battle of Kwamanso on 18 January 1824 the Asante army was checked frontally and on both wings at once, its columns were cut, its morale broke, and it was driven off under the British pursuit. The British advanced into Kumasi, great stretches of the town were burned with its stockades and roofs, and the king and the members of the court had long since gone; the authority of the empire retreated deep into the interior. The war ended with the peace of 1824: Asante renounced its suzerainty over the coastal states and recognised the independence of Fante and the others, returned British property including a captured European field gun, paid a heavy indemnity — recorded in British papers at about one hundred and twenty thousand pounds — and accepted the establishment of a British resident at Kumasi to supervise the terms. The old score of MacCarthy's death was settled at last, but the price was that Asante became, in British eyes, a state to be beaten down again and again. On the surface the Asante Empire was preserved and the succession continued, but in reality the balance of power on the Gold Coast had already been broken, and a tension lasting roughly half a century was left between Britain and Asante, which was not truly resolved until the third war, when the British blockaded the coast, and the fourth, when they stormed Kumasi.
